definitions.ask: Should this worker close bead sase-1r2.6 itself on the recorded green-run evidence?
definitions.why: Evidence is already on the bead; relaunching an xhigh worker just to re-verify costs far more

choices.label: Worker verifies the cited green runs and closes the bead itself with a stale-owner note
